description: Update MCP documentation and add deterministic catalog/config/credential/mode/proxy drift checks for the completed roadmap.
steps: Update README.md, docs/MCP_GUIDE.md, docs/kiro-mcp.example.json, and affected MCP docs for schema 22, current catalog fingerprint/counts, exact modes, import/XLSX/staged review, explicit prodrug/no-inference/durable comparison rules, provenance/origins, pagination/truncation, allowlists, credentials, reconnect, proxy links, and browser-only governance.
Make documentation-facing counts derive from or be checked against sar_mcp.catalog and reject stale unsupported browser/Kiro verification claims.

Add native config smoke for absolute paths, secret-free generated mcp.json, side-effect-safe autoApprove, mode visibility only after reconnect, sar_status mode reporting, base-origin API calls versus public-origin links, and credential round-trip/error secrecy.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation accurately describes all P0/P1/P2 coverage and the remaining browser/runtime limitations.
Catalog/schema/test/documentation drift fails deterministically and the selected three-mode model remains explicit.
Kiro config and proxy smoke passes without an external service and auto-approves only genuinely safe read tools.
verification: pixi run python -m pytest -q tests/test_mcp_catalog.py tests/test_mcp_unit.py tests/test_mcp_native_smoke.py
findings: Implements AC-027 through AC-032 and closes the roadmap’s documentation/configuration hardening gaps.
